title: Battery Charging Current Limit
text: Maximum battery charging current, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Algorithm data type} sets Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit:; {Specify inputs as [Min,Max]} sets the option to specify inputs as minimum and maximum, {Cell overvoltage limit (V)} sets the overvoltage limit for cell, {Terminal resistance (ohm)}, {Vector of temperatures, T} sets the cell temperatures, {Current limit for coolest cell, iCool(T), (A)} sets the current limit for coolest cell and {Current limit for hottest cell, iHot(T), (A)} sets the current limit for hottest cell. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CellTemperature
ports.summary: Temperature of cells, K scalar | vector

ports.summary: Charging current limit for battery pack scalar
